data.title: BlackRock leads $389M Bitcoin ETF exodus as November outflows hit a record
data.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs had $389 million in net outflows on November 27. Spot Ethereum ETFs lost another $69.27 million to redemptions the same day.Most of that money came out of BlackRock's products. It also puts November on track to be the worst month on record for Bitcoin ETF flows.BlackRock's iSha…
